inputs.original_text: These two middle school brothers in Michigan were forced to pull off their hoodies with "Let’s Go Brandon" on them after the school decided it could reasonably be seen as profane, and the lower courts backed that call. Now the case is heading to the U.S. Supreme Court with the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression claiming the school violated their First Amendment rights. That slogan took off in 2021 at a NASCAR event where the crowd was really yelling "F*** Joe Biden!" but the NBC interviewer just fed racer Brandon Brown the line that they were chanting "Let’s Go Brandon!" instead. This has nothing to do with any standard school rule on bad language. It's the elites and institutions working in coordination to stamp out open pushback against the official story by slapping a profane label on it and deploying schools and courts to enforce the silence. They're twisting everything to protect their narrative and stop people from seeing what the crowd was actually saying.

It's the elites and institutions working in coordination to stamp out open pushback against the official story by slapping a profane label on it and deploying schools and courts to enforce the silence. They're twisting everything to protect their narrative and stop people from seeing what the crowd was actually saying.
